messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high error rate detected on /v1/generate in us-west-2. 500s spike starting ~5m ago. Paging on-call.

mike: I'm on it. seeing a spike in container restarts on gpu-pool-3. throwing OOM/CUDA errors in prefill phase.

sara: @mike linking the tail logs?

mike: logs excerpt: ```Aug 13 12:34:21 gpu-node-7 containerd[1]: runtime error: CUDA out of memory. attempted allocation 2.1GiB. stack: runtime.cc:245, cuda_kernels.cc:112```

devon: confirmed — multiple pods have RestartCount > 3 in last 2 min. Kube events show BackOff.

mike: Impact: some users hitting 502/503 when requests include long contexts (>= 64k tokens equivalent). Looks specific to prefill allocation path.

tal: any recent rollout? model changes? quantization toggles?

mike: No recent model deployments. We did increase allowed prompt_size in proxy rules last week (to support long-document usecases).

ops-runner: Rapid mitigation options: 1) rollback prompt_size change on ingress proxy 2) routing long-context traffic to CPU fallback (slower) 3) cordon/evict noisy pods 4) temporarily scale down max concurrency per pod.

sara: First, throttle/deny huge prefill requests at the gateway — quick to implement. I'll push a patch to the edge proxy to add a prefill token-size guard and return 413 for > 200k bytes.

mike: +1 do that now. Also we should take noisy nodes out of rotation to stop crash loops causing k8s flapping.

devon: I'm running: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7 && kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` on the affected node, migrating stable pods.

incident-bot: NOTE: escalation to eng-runtime required. Pages sent to #eng-runtime on-call.

tal: I'll triage the runtime path — likely the prefill memory accounting isn't capping KV cache reservation for long prompts. We'll add a short-term guard in the runtime that rejects prefill if estimated KV bytes > X.

mike: gateway patch deployed (rolled back prompt_size change + gate: max_prefill_bytes=200000). Testing now.

ops-runner: cordon + drain completed for gpu-node-7. Migrated 6 pods; 2 pods failed to schedule due to capacity — routed some traffic to smaller model variant.

sara: Observability: created Grafana dashboard panel for prefill allocation size distribution and pod restart_rate. Also added an alert rule to fire at restart_count>2 in 5m.

devon: Runtime patch: pushed a hotfix to reject prefill > 1.5GiB estimated allocation. This returns a controlled 413 with message "context too large; consider truncation or using long-context tier".

mike: After patch + cordon + gateway rollback, error rates down to baseline; no more OOM restarts in last 10m. Latency for long-context requests increased because they were rerouted to smaller model variant / CPU fallback.

customer-success: CS note: ~3 customers saw transient 503s for 6–12 min. We will notify them: brief outage due to internal OOM protection; no data loss. I'll draft communications.

tal: Root cause hypothesis: prefill alloc path didn't properly bound KV cache allocations for extreme token counts combined with certain kernel memory fragmentation on older A100s. Large prefill attempted to allocate contiguous GPU buffers and failed leading to OOM -> container restart.

mike: Action items (short): 1) permanent gate in gateway to enforce token limits per plan 2) runtime: early estimate+reject + graceful fallback to small-model/CPU 3) infra: mark older nodes as low-priority for long-context workloads 4) postmortem with mitigations and SLA impact numbers.

sara: Handoff — @mike taking lead on postmortem writeup, @tal to own runtime fix and tests, @devon to add node label enforcement, @ops-runner to run capacity plan for long-context.

mike: I'll start the incident doc and ping for review. cc @customer-success for customer comms.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> partial. monitoring. Next update in 30m or on demand.

customer-success: Drafted email: "We experienced a short disruption to generation services affecting long-context requests. Root cause: GPU memory exhaustion during request prefill. Impacted requests returned 503/413; no data leakage. Mitigation: gateway limits + runtime guard. We'll follow up with postmortem and timeline"

devon: Note for postmortem: include heap/kv cache accounting snippet and sample failing log (from pod): ```[2026-08-13T12:34:21Z] ERROR runtime: cudaMemcpy failed: out of memory (2) at prefill.cc:87```

mike: Thanks team. Closing on-call loop — will update thread with postmortem link once ready.
